name: Runner Tests Fixture - Emit Exclusion Bundle Broken
brief: The suite whose only object cannot bind, so its whole module is dropped from the bundle.
description: Sibling of the healthy suite in the same bundle. Its object cannot bind, so the emit-retry loop excludes it and the runner empties this module's sources. It therefore contributes ZERO tests to the bundle while the healthy sibling still contributes a passing one — the exact shape in which the bundle-level loudness guard used to go quiet.
